subject: Best solution to create lavaan object based diagrams

messages.author: 9a8f7a9bed77c44a
messages.subject: Best solution to create lavaan object based diagrams
parts:
Hi!

Which is the package/script that you recommend using with lavaan fit object in order to create publishable diagrams? I saw lavaanPlot but currently it only path analysis models are supported.

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: Best solution to create lavaan object based diagrams
parts:
I've never found software that can draw publishable diagrams automatically. You always need more flexibility than they can give you to tweak things like sizes, labels, fonts, etc.

I like to use powerpoint, or Google Slides, or something like that.

Jeremy
